run_migrate_checkpoint_cli: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI to convert an OCP checkpoint to fm_release format with --checkpoint-in and --checkpoint-out
run_migrate_checkpoint_add_stress: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI with --add-stress to automatically add stress tasks for datasets missing them
run_migrate_checkpoint_remove_static: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI with --no-remove-static-keys to preserve static keys in the migrated checkpoint
run_migrate_checkpoint_model_version: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI with --model-version to set a specific model version in the backbone config
run_migrate_checkpoint_task_add_stress: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI with task_add_stress to copy stress task configs to datasets that lack them
